# Refactor Mode - Neros

## Rules

- Preserve behavior.
- Move one boundary at a time.
- Keep Domain pure, API thin, Application as use cases and Blazor UI-only.
- Do not reformat unrelated files.
- Do not change schema without a manual SQL script plan.
- Validate after each meaningful slice.

## Output

- Current smell.
- Target shape.
- Steps.
- Risk.
- Validation.
